subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor, recados, avisos, convites, receitas, instruções de montagem, dentre outros gêneros do campo da vida cotidiana, que possam ser repassados oralmente por meio de ferramentas digitais, em áudio ou vídeo, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto/finalidade do texto.

components.description_pt: Planejar colaborativamente textos do dia a dia como mensagens, avisos ou convites adequados à situação comunicativa
components.description_en: Plan collaboratively everyday-life texts such as messages, notices, or invitations suited to their communicative situation
components.cc_component_description: Organize informational or explanatory writing in a manner suited to purpose and audience

components.description_pt: Planejar colaborativamente textos procedimentais como receitas ou instruções de montagem adequados ao propósito
components.description_en: Plan collaboratively procedural texts such as recipes or assembly instructions suited to their purpose
components.cc_component_description: Plan writing with attention to purpose and intended audience

components.description_pt: Adaptar textos do dia a dia planejados para apresentação oral por meio de ferramentas de áudio ou vídeo digitais
components.description_en: Adapt planned everyday-life texts for oral delivery through digital audio or video tools
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools to produce and format a piece of writing for publication

cc_matches.description: Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
Use technology, including the Internet, to produce and publish writing and to interact and collaborate with others.

With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on how well purpose and audience have been addressed.
